Sure! Here are some nouns that meet your criteria (three letters or less, with at least two letters being the same):

1. Bee
2. Egg
3. Eye
4. Inn
5. Mom
6. Dad
7. Pop
8. Mum
9. Boo

These words have at most three letters and at least two repeated letters.
